test_title: PYST 40: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 1st November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the set of words that is best represented by the given Venn diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0948e01acbe44b0da4cf0c14f71426e286db87ce17640a9faa9a0356c5c5ec0f.png]
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given relation is as shown below :-

 
• All mothers are daughters. But it is possible some daughters are not mothers. 
 
• All Mothers and daughters are Females.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/753f4972879093d4db20548903fd85fd5a932000456007f619df9dfc49049805.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Females, Mothers, Daughters".**
